## canvas

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `width` | integer | Frame width in px. Default 1200. |
| `height` | integer | Frame height in px. Default 630 (classic) or 900 (2.5d, map). |
| `mode` | classic \| 2.5d \| board \| map | classic (default), 2.5d, board or map. |
| `theme` | string or object | Palette name or { from, harmony, mood }. See `scenec catalog themes`. |
| `time` | golden \| noon \| overcast \| dusk \| night | Time of day: golden, noon, overcast, dusk or night. |
| `kit` | string | Style kit name. See `scenec catalog kits`. |
| `colors` | object | Overrides theme colors, for example wall or floor. |
| `setting` | outdoor \| indoor \| beach \| city | Where the scene happens. Default outdoor. |
| `scale` | number | Camera zoom. Default 1. |
| `horizon` | number | Horizon line as a fraction of the height. |
| `base` | number | Baseline of the nearest ground objects as a fraction of the height. |
| `floor` | string | Indoor floor style, for example planks. |
| `vanish` | number | Vanishing point x for planks. |
| `haze` | boolean | false turns atmospheric perspective off. |
| `grain` | boolean |  |
| `light` | false or object | false, or { from: left\|right\|front\|0..1, strength: 0..1 }. |
| `critique` | boolean | false turns the art director off. |
| `shot` | wide \| full \| medium \| close | Framing: wide (default), full, medium or close. |
| `focus` | string or string[] | Object or group ids the shot frames. |
| `frame` | number or left \| center \| right | Where the focus sits horizontally. |
| `headroom` | number | Space above the focus as a fraction of the height. |
| `camera` | board \| room or object | 2.5d camera: board (high and far, default) or room (real perspective, for interiors), with optional overrides. |
| `depth` | number |  |
| `far_y` | number |  |
| `near_y` | number |  |
| `horizon_z` | number |  |

## Vocabulary

- `slots`: far-left, left, center-left, center, center-right, right, far-right
- `sizes`: tiny, small, medium, large, huge
- `depths`: far, mid, near
- `settings`: outdoor, indoor, beach, city
- `shots`: wide, full, medium, close
